user.title: Set up Power Fingerprint
user.description: Choose the whole-house power sensor and unmetered loads to fingerprint. Power Fingerprint learns validated residual-power profiles, integrates trustworthy device energy, and can graduate mature deterministic profiles to local Powercalc models.

data.use_energy_dashboard_meters: Subtract Energy Dashboard device power sensors automatically
data.auto_export_energy_dashboard: Automatically add Energy-ready devices to Energy Dashboard
data.excluded_meters: Energy Dashboard power sensors to exclude

data_description.tracked_entities: Select physical loads only. Climate entities are handled by the same live-isolation engine as all other devices; hvac_action supplies activity channels when available.
data_description.auto_export_energy_dashboard: When a device accumulates enough validated live-isolation evidence, add its isolated energy and power sensors to Energy Dashboard device consumption automatically.
data_description.additional_meters: These are subtracted from whole-house power in addition to Energy Dashboard meters.
data_description.excluded_meters: Use this if a displayed Energy Dashboard power sensor is already included inside another top-level meter.

error.unsupported_domain: One or more selected tracked entities use an unsupported domain.

init.title: Power Fingerprint options
init.description: Entity selections take effect after reload. Version 0.6.3 preserves learned records for temporarily untracked devices, uses generic device plausibility limits, prevents provisional profiles from being labeled Energy Dashboard ready, and supports excluding selected devices from unattended active calibration.
